Walk up to a mirror and click it to meet the champion inside.RESURRECT takes them as they are. REINCARNATE gives them a new name, wipes every skill they had and adds twelve points to their attributes.Take up to four. Click a champion's name at the top of the screen to open their inventory.Drop food or water on the mouth in the inventory to eat or drink, as the food and water bars there run low.Keep a lit torch in a hand: the dungeon is dark.At the top of an inventory, the disk icon saves and ZZZ rests the party; a click wakes it. Save often.Mouse and touchEvery action is on the screen; a tap is a click. The arrows move, the hands above them fight, the runes above those cast.Click an object on the floor to take it: it becomes the pointer. Click the floor to drop it, the middle of the view to throw it.Click a wall's button or lever to use it, a keyhole with the key in hand.
